qa_pair.question: What is the standard 10-character Plus Code for Africa Unity Square in Harare, at latitude -17.8292 and longitude 31.0522? Answer with the code only.
Computing the Plus Code for latitude -17.8292, longitude 31.0522 at code length 11 instead of 10 appends exactly one character. Which character? Answer with that single character.
Do the 10-character Plus Codes of Victoria Falls town (-17.9243, 25.8572) and Livingstone (-17.8419, 25.8543) share the same first four characters? Respond True or False.

What are the first four characters of the 10-character Plus Code for the Kenyatta International Convention Centre in Nairobi (latitude -1.2884, longitude 36.8233)? Answer with the four characters only.
What is the coarsest Plus Code (code length 4) for Lagos Island at latitude 6.4541, longitude 3.3947? Answer with the full code as returned, including padding and the plus sign.

In the 10-character Plus Code for the Castle of Good Hope in Cape Town (latitude -33.9258, longitude 18.4276), which character comes immediately after the plus sign? Answer with that single character.
Of Accra (latitude 5.55, longitude -0.2) and Kumasi (latitude 6.6885, longitude -1.6244), which city's 10-character Plus Code begins with "6CR"? Answer Accra or Kumasi.
On the Kweli verification ladder, which tier label carries the Gold badge mineral? Answer with the label exactly as Kweli reports it.
Which badge mineral marks the highest tier on the Kweli verification ladder? Answer with the mineral name only.
Kweli describes one tier as "Contact Verified". What is that tier's number on the ladder? Answer with the number only.
